Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Refer to System Event Codes below

Field.Name: Current Year
Field.Description: The current calendar year (example: 2016).

Field.Name: Current Month
Field.Description: The current calendar month, with values 1 to 12 inclusive, January=1, etc.

Field.Name: Current Day
Field.Description: The current calendar day, with values 1 to 31 inclusive.

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: Version of this interface. Currently set to 1.

Field.Name: Sub-version
Field.Description: Sub-version of this interface. Currently set to 0.

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Directory Message
Message.Description: Whenever a complex order is added in the system for an underlying, the order is normalized and results in either the creation of a new complex strategy or is added to an existing strategy. A Complex Strategy Message containing the strategy definition will be sent.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: ISE’s Strategy ID assigned daily, valid while there are any open complex orders for the day

Field.Name: StrategyType
Field.Description: The kind of strategy the legs below make up

Field.Name: Source
Field.Description: Identifies the source of the Strategy, valid for the trading day

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying Symbol for the strategy. All legs in this strategy belong to this Underlying

Field.Name: Number of Legs
Field.Description: Number of legs in the strategy

Field.Name: Leg Information
Field.Description: Leg information, legs repeated. n = 0, 1 and so on...

Message.Name: Strategy Trading Action Message
Message.Description: ISE uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a strategy within the ISE Options Market. Messages will be sent when the strategy is halted or is released for trading.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: ISE’s Strategy ID assigned daily, valid while there are any open complex orders for the day

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the strategy on the ISE market.

Message.Name: Strategy Open Closed Message
Message.Description: The options system uses this administrative message to indicate when a strategy has completed the opening process and is now available for auto execution or when the option has closed and is no longer available for auto execution.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Open State
Field.Description: Reflects the current eligibility for auto execution of the options security in the options market.

Message.Name: Strategy Depth Incremental Message
Message.Description: This message is used to send information regarding any of the top five price levels of an option’s order book. The message may contain multiple repeating items, each of which updates one side of one price level. All repeating items within the message relate to the same option.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the strategy, as defined in the Strategy Directory Message

Field.Name: Quote Condition
Field.Description: Whether the strategy is quoting regularly or is pre-open or halted

Field.Name: Bid Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregate market size on Bid side.

Field.Name: Ask MarketSize
Field.Description: The aggregate market size on Ask side.

Field.Name: Bid NTT Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregate market size on Bid side.

Field.Name: Ask NTT MarketSize
Field.Description: The aggregate market size on Ask side.

Field.Name: Number of Depth Incrementals
Field.Description: Number of times the following 7 fields repeat. If the number of incrementals is N (the value of this field), then the offsets are evaluated “N” times, with values 0 to N-1 inclusive.

Field.Name: Depth Incrementals
Field.Description: Repeated Number of Depth Incrementals times

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Ticker Message
Message.Description: The ticker message is used to send real time trade information.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the strategy, as defined in the Complex StrategyDirectory Message.

Field.Name: Last Price
Field.Description: Most recent price.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Last traded quantity.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Total traded quantity.

Field.Name: High
Field.Description: High price for the day.

Field.Name: Low
Field.Description: Low price for the day.

Field.Name: First
Field.Description: Opening price for the day

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Same value as the Trade Condition sent to OPRA for this trade. To obtain a list of Trade Conditions, refer to the NOTES below.

Group.Name: Leg Information
Group.Description: Leg information, legs repeated. n = 0, 1 and so on...

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: ISE’s Option ID for this leg, valid for the trading day. The same ID as the corresponding Option in the Options Directory Message. Zero (0) for Stock Leg.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the option root symbol (security symbol)

Field.Name: Leg ID
Field.Description: Leg identifier within this strategy. This is an exchange-assigned 0-based index. E.g. Nth leg has LegId=N-1.

Field.Name: Expiration Year
Field.Description: Last two digits of the year of the option expiration

Field.Name: Expiration Month
Field.Description: Expiration Month of the option (1-12)

Field.Name: Expiration Day
Field.Description: Day of the Month of expiration (1-31)

Field.Name: Explicit Strike Price
Field.Description: Denotes the explicit strike price of the option. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes. Zero (0) for Stock Leg.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Indicates the side of the leg

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg Ratio

Group.Name: Depth Incrementals
Group.Description: One update of one side of one price level. The Price, Size, Cust Size, ProCust Size and NTTSize fields are present for New and Change Update Actions only; if Update Action is Delete or Delete From they are absent, so the entry is 23 or 3 bytes long.

Field.Name: Update Action
Field.Description: What the update does to the price level

Field.Name: Depth Side
Field.Description: The side of the book the update is on

Field.Name: Level
Field.Description: The numeric order of the price level, where “1” is the (best) price level. With is feed, this field has a value from 1 to 5 inclusive.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price level’s price (fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits). Present for New and Change Update Actions only.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of aggregated contracts in price level. Present for New and Change Update Actions only.

Field.Name: Cust Size
Field.Description: Aggregated Customer Professional quantity in the price level. Present for New and Change Update Actions only.

Field.Name: ProCust Size
Field.Description: Aggregated Customer quantity in the price level. Present for New and Change Update Actions only.

Field.Name: NTTSize
Field.Description: Limit size that can’t be traded through. Present for New and Change Update Actions only.

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Start of Messages. This is always the first message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: Start of System Hours. This message indicates that the options system is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Opening Process
Value.Description: Start of Opening Process. This message is intended to indicate that the options system has started its opening auction process.

Value.Name: Start of Normal Hours Closing Process
Value.Description: Start of Normal Hours Closing Process. This message is intended to indicate that the options system will no longer generate new executions for options that trade during normal hours.

Value.Name: Start of Late Hours Closing Process
Value.Description: Start of Late Hours Closing Process. This message is intended to indicate that the options system will no longer generate new executions for options that trade during extended hours.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: End of System Hours. This message indicates that the options system is now closed.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: End of Messages. This is always the last message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: End of WCO Early closing
Value.Description: End of WCO Early closing. This message is intended to indicate that the exchange will no longer accept any new orders or changes to existing Orders on last trading date of WCO options.

Value.Name: New
Value.Description: New price level, to be inserted at the specified price level

Value.Name: Change
Value.Description: Change at the given price level

Value.Name: Delete
Value.Description: The indicated price level is to be deleted

Value.Name: Delete From
Value.Description: All price levels starting at the indicated price level are to be deleted
